articles.title: Trump Visits Army War College to Talk About Big Military Tech—But There’s a Missile Shortage
articles.summary: President Trump spoke at a defense summit in Pennsylvania, promising investments in battlefield technology. But the war in Iran has used up many Tomahawk missiles and Patriot interceptors. It could take three years to restock.

articles.title: UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer Says Goodbye in His Final Question Time—With Jokes and Tears
articles.summary: At his last Prime Minister’s Questions, Keir Starmer said it was the “end of my political journey.” MPs from all parties shared jokes and praise. He’ll hand over to Andy Burnham on Monday. Some allies cried.

articles.title: Can the Top Lawyer Be Fair? Senators Ask Tough Questions
articles.summary: Imagine your lawyer also had to be fair to everyone, even people you don't like. That's the big question for Todd Blanche, Trump's former personal lawyer, now hoping to lead the whole Justice Department. Senators are worried he might only protect the president.
